newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures regain some ground, still weak.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures regain some ground, still weak.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures recovered from their lows but remained depressed by the close of Friday trade, dealers said.
They said uncertainty over the Dow's direction clouded the horizon for Nikkei cash and futures markets.
Nikkei 225 March futures fell through the key 20,000 points support level to a low of 19,950 early in the day as Wall Street's steep drop overnight weighed on sentiment.
But the March contract recovered to close at 20,320 against a previous close at 20,555. Volume was an active 23,500 lots.
"The close at 20,320 is still not healthy but it should slow the day-to-day down move," said a trader with a local house.
He said the March Nikkei needed to close above 20,150 in the near term in order to test higher resistance at 20,590.
On the downside, the contract is likely to be supported between 19,950 and 20,050.
"People are very nervous about the U.S. market. Any rumour just triggers a sell-off," said a trader with a Japanese house.
The Dow lost nearly 100 points on Thursday as poor sentiment triggered waves of programme selling.

The trader said Wall Street's extended rally this year had raised concerns of a possible sharp correction, a notion that was reinforced by Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's comment last week about "irrational exuberance" in U.S. stock and bond markets.
